observations: Black game console with a white controller on top.
The console is sitting on a black stand with 'PS4' visible on the front.
The console has a glossy finish and a power indicator light is visible.
The background is a grey stone-patterned wall.
There is a watermark 'SAMUEL OKEREKE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' across the image.

claims.evidence: The console appears clean in the photo, but internal condition and dust cannot be seen.
Only one controller is visible in photo 0.
No games are visible on the console or in the photo.
The storage capacity is not visible on the console in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus.

risks.risk: The games may be digital accounts tied to a different region or account.
risks.proof: A photo of the physical game cases or the digital library screen.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the home screen.
Photo of the game library or physical game cases.
Video of the controller being used to navigate menus.
Photo of the system information screen showing the storage capacity.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Sony PS4 from the photos. It can be priced at its worst case (non-working) until proof of functionality and the presence of games is provided.
